# T-2: Separate current artifact

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Make `final-regression-result.json` represent only the latest invocation and keep historical failure data in issue-log entries.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Pass and fail result artifacts omit `previousFailureKind`.
- Failure issue-log entries retain the failureKind, command, rawOutputPath, retryable, nextAction, and timestamp needed for audit.

## Implementation Notes
Remove previousFailureKind from the artifact class and validator expectations. Preserve previous failure counts only as internal retry-decision input, not as artifact output.

## Test Strategy
Unit tests run final-regression after prior issue-log failure entries and assert the latest result artifact has no past-failure fields.
